# Summary

# Key facts
- **Focus keyword:** kitchen sink clogged on both sides (880/mo, KD 19, CPC $18.90; Search Atlas saved project 5053186). Not chased: "clogged kitchen sink" 6,600 (KD 71), "slow draining sink" (KD 66).
- **Title:** Kitchen Sink Clogged on Both Sides? Causes and Fixes. **H1:** Kitchen Sink Clogged on Both Sides? What It Means and How to Fix It. Slug /kitchen-sink-clogged-both-sides/ (was free).
- Low cannibalization risk; an old drain-care draft already 301s to /sewer-line-maintenance/.
- Schema: BlogPosting from the article schema mu-plugin, FAQPage from `_pipeliners_faq_jsonld` (5 FAQs), title and meta via the post-seo-meta mu-plugin.
- **Status:** approved Oct 2 and built as Elementor draft post 18219. `publish.php` publishes 18219 with Article schema, the SEO meta entry and 2 inbound links; the `fix-backups\2026-10-02_kitchen-sink-publish\` set (backups of posts 18123 and 18157) indicates it was published around Oct 2.
